# task\-bun\-1\-4\-embedded\-dashboard — Embed the dashboard in the Bun 1\.4 executable
status: in_progress  priority: 2  scope: scope-dashboard
readiness: not_eligible  reason: status_in_progress

Use Bun 1\.4's bun build \-\-compile \-\-asset support to make the production dashboard part of the standalone Waystation executable\. Add one canonical frontend/build pipeline, resolve embedded production assets relative to the executable rather than the target ledger root, retain the Vite development workflow, and verify that a copied binary can serve the React application and API from an unrelated project without Waystation source files or a separate dashboard dist directory\.

## Acceptance
- A canonical package script builds the Vite dashboard before compiling waystation\.exe, and the compile command embeds src/dashboard/client/dist with Bun 1\.4 \-\-asset\.
- Production dashboard asset resolution works from Bun's embedded filesystem and does not derive the frontend dist path from the target ledger root\.
- Source mode and dashboard \-\-dev continue to use the existing Vite workflow with HMR and API proxy behavior\.
- A compiled waystation\.exe copied to an unrelated directory can target a fixture ledger and return HTTP 200 for /, /favicon\.ico when present, and at least one hashed frontend asset without any source checkout or external dist directory\.
- Compiled\-mode smoke coverage verifies SPA fallback, API routes, graph asset routing, correct content types, missing\-file behavior, and protection against path traversal outside the embedded asset root\.
- CLI and MCP modes of the same compiled executable still start and pass their existing smoke tests after assets are embedded\.
- Binary distribution, MCP, release, and README documentation use the canonical dashboard\-build\-and\-compile command and explain that the dashboard is self\-contained\.
- bun test, bun run typecheck, bun run check, source\-mode dashboard tests, compiled\-dashboard smoke tests, and waystation validate all pass\.
